author: Jay
name: RoleGate
short: Button role panel with admin approval for gated roles.
description: Members pick roles from a button panel. Open roles are granted instantly; approval roles post a request card to a private channel where moderators with Manage Roles approve or deny it. Members can always remove their own roles. Buttons keep working across restarts.
install_msg: Set up with [p]rolegate channel #approvals, then [p]rolegate add @Role [approval|open] [label] for each role, then [p]rolegate post [#channel]. The bot needs the Manage Roles permission, and its own role must sit above every role it hands out.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs for pending role requests only. They are removed once a request is approved or denied.
